decisions.quote: Is the role of economic conditions on the changes in U.S. farm numbers still the same? Is this role the same for changes in the number of midsize farms in the U.S. and in other countries? To answer these questions, we replicate Gale (1990) time series regression, expand the model to include more variables and more years, and apply the model to farm numbers by farm size categories and for other countries and regions.
decisions.reason: Rather than only re-analyzing Gale (1990)'s original dataset, the authors collect data from updated statistical sources for 1960-1988 and extend the sample to 1960-2020, U.S. farm size categories, Brazil, and the Eurozone to re-test whether Gale (1990)'s findings still hold.

decisions.quote: Our replication analysis confirms the original findings that the economic factors have more significant importance in the second subperiod, while in the first subperiod there is a strong downward trend in the number of farms with less influence from the economic factors.
decisions.reason: Despite some differences in individual coefficient magnitudes and significance, the authors state an explicit overall verdict that their replication and extension confirm Gale (1990)'s main conclusions regarding the role of economic factors versus long-term trends.
